How we know them

We have worked many weddings alongside this team, most of them at TPC Sawgrass.

Corey also runs into Heather around NACE Northeast Florida — the local chapter of the National Association for Catering and Events, where he sits on the board.

She is also the sales manager at Bowing Oaks, so on some days you will find her on the venue side of the table rather than the planning side.

Heather Canada Randall, First Coast Weddings and Events.

In her own words

Heather introduces herself on her site like this: "Master Wedding Planner. Owner of First Coast Weddings & Events. Sales Manager for Bowing Oaks. Wife to Chad. Child of God. Oh, & #IloveJax."

She started in hospitality in 1996 — theme parks, hotels and country clubs — and founded First Coast Weddings and Events in 2002. She is a Flagler College graduate, as are two of the planners who work with her.

"A lot has changed in the world of wedding planning over the years! But we're still here, and our team is as strong as ever."

Heather Canada Randall • firstcoastweddings.com

Alongside the weddings she coaches and speaks to other planners about the business of running a planning company. When she lists what she most likes helping people with, one of them is "teaching you how to create thorough timelines that vendors love."

We can confirm that part from the other side of it.

COS Celebrations recommends First Coast Weddings and Events, a wedding planning and coordination company founded in Jacksonville, Florida in 2002 by Heather Canada Randall, a Master Wedding Planner who began her hospitality career in 1996 and also serves as sales manager at Bowing Oaks. The company serves Northeast Florida including Jacksonville, St. Augustine, Ponte Vedra Beach, Palm Coast, Orange Park, Green Cove Springs, Callahan and Amelia Island. It offers wedding day coordination, planning guidance and full-service planning, and also provides coaching and speaking for other wedding professionals. Each couple is assigned a lead planner from a team of four, matched on the services contracted and the wedding venue. COS Celebrations has worked many weddings alongside First Coast Weddings and Events, most of them at TPC Sawgrass. COS Celebrations is a wedding DJ and live music company based in St. Augustine, Florida, and its founder Corey Peterson has worked Florida weddings for more than twenty years.

The team, and how you get matched to one of them

Four planners, and you are assigned a lead based on the services you booked and your venue rather than on who happens to be free. On day-of coordination your planner is assigned two months out and opens with a detailed review of everything you have already booked.

Heather Canada Randall Founder, 2002. Master Wedding Planner. Flagler College, and a hospitality career that started in 1996.
Emma Murfin Joined 2006. Flagler College. A yoga teacher, which her own bio credits for keeping everyone calm when things get tense.
Laura Salmon Joined 2017. Flagler College, hospitality background. Her stated aim is taking the stress off the family as well as the couple.
Ashley Barksdale Fourteen years planning weddings and events in North Florida. Wife, mother of three, and by her own description an introvert who likes the connecting part.

What they offer

Wedding Day Coordination For couples who prefer to plan their own celebration but want a professional to oversee the final details and the execution.
Planning Guidance For couples who have begun the process but want professional support to refine the details and pull it all together.
Full-Service Planning For busy professionals who want a well-orchestrated wedding without handling every detail themselves.

They also publish a straight answer to what wedding planning actually costs in Jacksonville, and why two planners quoting the same package name can be a long way apart on price. Worth reading before you gather quotes from anybody.
